description: Reads a business's website (the home page and up to 8 more pages of the same site, honouring robots.txt) and drafts up to 12 questions its customers would ask, each answered only from text on one of those pages, with the page's address and the words quoted from it. Gemini drafts them without web search; then OOO Works' checks drop any answer whose quote isn't on the cited page word for word, or that has a number, price, time, phone number, link or boast that isn't on that page. Questions the site doesn't answer are listed separately, as what to add. Returns the FAQ, an HTML block and FAQPage JSON-LD to paste. Nothing is changed on the site. Limited to 5 a day per caller; a site is read at most once a day and the same site and language are answered from memory for 24 hours.

language.description: language to write the FAQ in: en (default) or ko

url.description: the business's website, e.g. example.com; its home page and up to 8 more pages of the same site are read

name: draft_faq_page
title: Draft a FAQ page from a business's own website
